mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seen_stream_control(stream,cluster_id,topic_id,topic,group_id) VALUES(#{c.stream},#{c.clusterId},#{c.topicId},#{c.topic},#{c.groupId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM seen_stream_control WHERE stream=#{stream} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE seen_stream_control SET initializing_command_id=#{id} WHERE stream=#{stream} AND initializing_command_id IS NULL
UPDATE seen_stream_control SET initializing_command_id=NULL WHERE stream=#{stream} AND initializing_command_id=#{id}
UPDATE seen_stream_control SET stop_reason=#{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE stream=#{stream}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM seen_stream_partition WHERE stream=#{stream} ORDER BY partition_id LIMIT 32
mapper.update: UPDATE seen_record SET status='PAUSED',lease_until=NULL,last_error='DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE' WHERE record_id IN (SELECT record_id FROM seen_record WHERE stream=#{stream} AND active_command_id IS NULL AND status='APPLYING' AND attempts=3 AND lease_until<=clock_timestamp() LIMIT 32)
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT 1 FROM seen_record WHERE stream=#{stream} AND (status='PAUSED' OR active_command_id IS NOT NULL OR (status='APPLYING' AND attempts=3 AND lease_until<=clock_timestamp())) LIMIT 1) b
SELECT FROM seen_record WHERE stream=#{stream} AND partition_id=#{partition} AND record_offset=#{offset}
SELECT FROM seen_record WHERE record_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE seen_record SET status='PAUSED',lease_until=NULL,last_error='DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE' WHERE record_id=#{id} AND active_command_id IS NULL AND status='APPLYING' AND attempts=3 AND lease_until<=clock_timestamp()

UPDATE seen_record SET status='APPLYING',attempts=attempts+1,fence=fence+1,lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds' WHERE record_id=#{id} AND active_command_id IS NULL AND status IN ('READY','APPLYING') AND attempts<3 AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=clock_timestamp()) AND next_attempt_at<=clock_timestamp()

UPDATE seen_record SET status=#{status},lease_until=NULL,last_error=#{error,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, last_success_at=CASE WHEN #{status}='APPLIED' THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE last_success_at END WHERE record_id=#{id} AND fence=#{fence} AND status='APPLYING' AND lease_until>clock_timestamp()

UPDATE seen_record SET status=CASE WHEN attempts=3 THEN 'PAUSED' ELSE 'READY' END,lease_until=NULL, last_error=#{error},next_attempt_at=clock_timestamp()+#{delay}*interval '1 millisecond' WHERE record_id=#{id} AND fence=#{fence} AND status='APPLYING' AND lease_until>clock_timestamp()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seen_recovery_command(command_id,kind,stream,record_id,request_json,request_digest,actor,reason,before_status,before_epoch,before_attempts) VALUES(#{c.commandId},#{c.kind},#{c.stream},#{c.recordId,jdbcType=OTHER},#{c.requestJson},#{c.requestDigest},#{c.actor},#{c.reason}, #{c.beforeStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR},#{c.beforeEpoch,jdbcType=BIGINT},#{c.beforeAttempts,jdbcType=INTEGER}) ON CONFLICT(command_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM seen_recovery_command WHERE command_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE seen_recovery_command SET status='RUNNING',attempts=attempts+1,fence=fence+1,lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds' WHERE command_id=#{id} AND status IN ('READY','RUNNING') AND attempts<3 AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=clock_timestamp()) AND next_attempt_at<=clock_timestamp()

UPDATE seen_record SET active_command_id=#{command},epoch=epoch+1,attempts=0,lease_until=NULL,next_attempt_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE record_id=#{id} AND active_command_id IS NULL AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=clock_timestamp())

UPDATE seen_record SET status='APPLYING',attempts=attempts+1,fence=fence+1,lease_until=clock_timestamp()+interval '30 seconds' WHERE record_id=#{id} AND active_command_id IS NOT NULL AND attempts<3 AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=clock_timestamp())

UPDATE seen_recovery_command SET status=#{status},result=#{result},lease_until=NULL,completed_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE command_id=#{id} AND fence=#{fence} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_until>clock_timestamp()

UPDATE seen_recovery_command SET status=CASE WHEN attempts=3 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'READY' END,result=#{error},lease_until=NULL, completed_at=CASE WHEN attempts=3 THEN clock_timestamp() ELSE NULL END,next_attempt_at=clock_timestamp()+#{delay}*interval '1 millisecond' WHERE command_id=#{id} AND fence=#{fence} AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_until>clock_timestamp()

UPDATE seen_recovery_command SET status='FAILED',result='DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE',completed_at=clock_timestamp(),lease_until=NULL WHERE command_id=#{id} AND status='RUNNING' AND attempts=3 AND lease_until<=clock_timestamp()
UPDATE seen_record SET active_command_id=NULL,status=#{status},lease_until=NULL WHERE record_id=#{id} AND active_command_id=#{command}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM seen_record WHERE status='QUARANTINED' AND (created_at,record_id)>(#{at},#{id}) ORDER BY created_at,record_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT count(*) FROM seen_record WHERE stream='LEGACY' AND status=#{status}
SELECT COALESCE(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (clock_timestamp()-min(created_at))),0)::double precision FROM seen_record WHERE stream='LEGACY' AND status IN ('READY','APPLYING','PAUSED')
